opening.question: Does the opening establish the subject and visual identity?
opening.evidence: Frame at 0.3s (review-beats, before the s2 revision; s1 unchanged since) shows amber TWO and teal ground already on screen; subject and palette identifiable at frame 0.

narrative.question: Is the narrative understandable?
narrative.evidence: Beat frames show hook (TWO TIDES) -> diagram (2 BULGES with near/far labels) -> 12.4h -> The Moon sets the clock; the claim, cause, number and takeaway follow in order.

scene-purpose.question: Does every scene have a clear purpose?
scene-purpose.evidence: every scene has purpose + viewerShouldNotice; none flagged generic

variation.question: Is there meaningful visual variation?
variation.evidence: Grounds teal / deep teal / amber / teal and four different layouts seen in review-beats; hero move differs per scene (reveal, ellipse growth, counter, line reveal).

typography.question: Is the typography readable and well composed?
typography.evidence: Archivo Black headlines 150-440px and Inter 40-64px labels read clearly in frame 5.9s and review-beats; ink/ground contrast passed hyperframes contrast check. Not checked: phone-width strip (review-phone.jpg) was not opened.

transitions.question: Are transitions consistent and intentional?
transitions.evidence: Same left-to-right ground wipe at all three seams (seen mid-wipe in review-beats frames 3, 5, 7); each incoming scene has a different ground so the wipe is legible.

timing.question: Are there awkward gaps, overlaps or timing conflicts?

clipping.question: Are elements clipped or outside safe areas?
clipping.evidence: hyperframes check layout reports 0 errors/warnings; frames show all text inside margins. Mask overflow is intentional (data-layout-allow-overflow).

assets.question: Are images and assets used effectively?
assets.evidence: No external assets; all graphics are inline SVG/CSS drawn for the subject (no stock imagery).

arc.question: Does the video have a coherent beginning, middle and end?
arc.evidence: roles open with hook/context and close with payoff/resolution/cta

effects.question: Are there unnecessary effects or repetitive layouts?
effects.evidence: Source scan: no glow/blur/particles, no unlogged scene drift; every tween maps to the storyboard hero move or secondary callout.

technical.question: Does the project pass the supported technical checks?
technical.evidence: hyperframes check + lint + structure: no errors
